item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL DB Hyperscale Cross Database Querying
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale now supports native cross-database querying in public preview. Applications can access and join data across databases in the same Hyperscale elastic pool on a logical server using three-part T-SQL names.

  • Source: Azure Updates
